description:
[read-only] The brand's keyword triggers: a comment matching a keyword gets a public reply and/or a DM. Shows whether each is active and its counts.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/growth-triggers.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_growth_triggers
title: List comment-to-get triggers
